visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a black short-sleeved top, sits on a beige sofa in a modern living room. She holds a smartphone while looking at the camera. A large green plant is visible to the right. (2) A hand holds a closed Samsung Galaxy Z Flip foldable phone. The small rectangular cover screen displays a stylized animated character with glowing hair and a large hat. (3) The phone is opened to reveal its main vertical screen. Fingers navigate through the 'Settings' menu, specifically clicking on 'Cover Screen' options. The interface is in Chinese. (4) The visual transitions to a screen capture/close-up of the customization process. The user selects a specific video file from the gallery and adjusts its positioning on the small screen layout. (5) Different clock styles, font types, and color palettes are cycled through on the customization interface. The person's nails are painted with a dark blue or black polish. (6) The phone is closed again to show the finalized dynamic wallpaper active on the cover screen. (7) The woman from the first phase is now standing in front of a white brick wall illuminated by bright purple and pink neon lights. She wears the same black top but has added a dark cowboy-style hat, mimicking the character on her phone screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 欸 粉絲請我們分享 三星摺疊機的 動態桌布怎麼弄!. (2) [Slogan]: 要下載 App 嗎?. (3) [Slogan]: 不用啊 你就先準備一支 15 秒內的影片. (4) [Slogan]: 然後打開你的 設定 往下滑到 封面螢幕 點進去. (5) [Slogan]: 點這邊的 新增 媒體瀏覽器 選你要設定的影片. (6) [Slogan]: 然後就是按照喜好 看你要把時鐘 弄成什麼樣子. (7) [Slogan]: 建議你可以選 第 5 個字體 加 第 1 個樣式. (8) [Slogan]: 讓時鐘的佔比 比較小喔!. (9) [Slogan]: 你也可以加個 外框之類的. (10) [Slogan]: 好了之後就按完成 這樣就設定好囉!. (11) [Slogan]: 天啊好帥 又多了個 換摺疊機的理由了!. (12) [Variety]: 我要掐死你!

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator demonstrating the phone.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with short dark hair, wearing a black t-shirt and occasionally a wide-brimmed hat.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Initially a bright, modern living room with a beige sofa, wooden furniture, and indoor plants. Later, a studio-like setting with a white brick wall and neon purple/pink ambient lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female Mandarin speech begins immediately over a bright, rhythmic electronic pop track. A 'whoosh' SFX accentuates the opening title. (2) A second female voice asks a brief question, followed quickly by the main narrator's instructional response. The music tempo remains consistent. (3) Continuous narration explains technical settings as soft digital UI 'click' SFX are heard periodically, synchronized with screen taps. (4) The music swells slightly in energy. (5) In the final phase, the music shifts to a more intense, bass-heavy electronic segment accompanied by a dramatic, high-arousal vocal shout/scream that is intended to be comedic.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Instruction -> Demonstration -> Result -> Comedic Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a quick, engaging tutorial for Samsung Galaxy Z Flip users on how to customize their cover screen with dynamic video wallpapers, utilizing a mix of direct instruction and personality-driven content.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed demonstration of specific smartphone features and the mention of the brand name in the subtitles.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-paced editing style typical of short-form social media platforms, blending utility (tutorial) with entertainment (cosplay/performance at the end).
